entries.launch-moved-explicitly:
The system prompt frames this as a baseline that treats any two decisions on the same subject as conflicting. Judging the actual content, though, the new decision does not truly conflict with the earlier one in the sense of contradicting it. It knowingly replaces it. The earlier decision's condition was "after the security review is complete", and the new decision cites that the review is now complete and signed off. So the earlier constraint is satisfied and the date is updated deliberately.

Still, the new decision does literally contradict the "not before 15 January" statement. It supersedes rather than conflicts unintentionally. I will report it, flagging it as a supersession with moderate confidence.
